cs.t: Spot on, my smart watch is an Amazfit, the built-in apps for sport, driving the music player, and reading msgs are enough. I agree reply is useless, it isn't even possible on this one, however it is good only as a reminder as sometimes I miss relevant calls or msgs. I have used smart watches since the Timex and Casio had agendas, or games, never cared for an app ecosystem beyond what was already on the phone. Also never changed the Amazfit skin since the day I bought it, and settled on a classical analogue view. Often I rather use a plain mechanical watch, or no watch at all, don't get the app ecosystem on a miniature screen.
